tracking: ADR-0339 (lane E20): API-only, master brief for lane E20 2026-11-16; the screen goes to the UI builder on #453

gaps.GET /v1/agent-risk: ranks agents (registry or builder) by their newest stored risk score, with the count not yet scored (admin)
gaps.GET /v1/agent-risk/:kind/:subjectId: one agent's live risk score: every factor with its OWASP ids, reach, toxic combinations and ranked fixes, plus the newest stored assessment
gaps.GET /v1/agent-risk/:kind/:subjectId/hist: pages one agent's stored risk assessments, newest first, each with what triggered it
gaps.POST /v1/agent-risk/recompute: runs the risk recompute sweep now, optionally for one agent (admin, audited per assessment)
